constraints: Preserve the existing Neyam brand identity and real restaurant copy
Keep interactive targets at least 44px high
Maintain WCAG AA color contrast and visible focus
Keep the application compatible with Next.js static export
Avoid generic SaaS cards, glass-heavy styling, and decorative gradients
Do not publish a phone number until the restaurant supplies one
Do not emit indexable metadata until a cafe-owned production domain is confirmed

decisions.choice: Use a light, logo-first hero with an unobstructed oversized Neyam wordmark, generated brass filter-kaapi cutout based on Neyam's real photograph, one dominant directions CTA, and restrained CSS 3D response.
references: Benne: centred brand canvas and confident negative space
UI/UX Pro Max: immersive interactive restaurant pattern
decisions.rationale: Makes the brand name fully legible, gives the first screen an unmistakably South Indian morning cue, and keeps directions as the clearest conversion priority.

decisions.choice: Carry the hero language through unboxed menu rows, monumental brand statements, a single signature-food theatre, and oversized Google proof.
decisions.rationale: Prevents the page from falling back into repetitive rounded cards after the hero.

decisions.choice: Reserve dimensional motion for the hero kaapi tumbler and signature dish; use slower entrance reveals elsewhere and disable decorative motion under reduced-motion preferences.
decisions.rationale: Adds tactile depth where it improves appetite appeal without turning the restaurant page into a demo reel.

decisions.choice: Use the sequence Hero, Signatures, Menu, Philosophy, Proof, Visit, FAQ with Directions dominant in the hero, header, mobile dock, and final visit section.
decisions.rationale: Balances brand storytelling with a clear path from appetite to an in-person visit.

decisions.choice: Finish Golden Morning with a disciplined serif/sans hierarchy, WCAG AA-safe text and control contrast, a calmer parchment Philosophy surface, finite decorative motion, a dedicated short-laptop hero composition, and a modal mobile drawer that makes the page inert while open.
references: 21st-ui-build: project-aware editorial composition and interaction review
UI/UX Pro Max: hierarchy, contrast, responsive height, motion, and modal accessibility guidance
decisions.rationale: The polish improves reading rhythm and conversion clarity while protecting keyboard, assistive-technology, reduced-motion, short-phone, tablet, and short-laptop experiences.
